headline: US maintains existing tariffs on Mexican goods
summary: The United States has maintained its tariff structure on Mexican goods following the midterm elections. This includes a 10% tariff on goods outside the USMCA and duties ranging from 25% to 50% on steel, aluminum, and automobiles.
why: Trade policy between the US and Mexico is a major driver of cross-border supply chains, particularly in the automotive and manufacturing sectors.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: High tariffs on automotive imports from Mexico increase costs for manufacturers and consumers.
